title: Forced-depth completion accepts a gapped iteration filename set because it checks only the count
evidence: countIterationFiles accepts any N regex-matching filenames and max-iterations validation compares only that count plus a max-family stop reason; it does not require the contiguous 1..N set or reconcile state-record iteration numbers.
recommendation: Require exact contiguous iteration numbers, reject out-of-range/gapped names, and cross-check unique state records before accepting forced-depth completion.
scopeProof: Read both completion branches and the directory count helper; the policy gate has no sequence or state cross-check.

title: Post-dispatch write containment can be bypassed through a symlink beneath the artifact directory
evidence: Artifact containment compares lexical Git-status paths and realpath-resolves only the artifact root; the review YAML repeats a resolve-only dirty-path comparison, so a descendant symlink can target outside the physical artifact tree without being detected.
recommendation: Reject symlink components or canonicalize every descendant path/parent before allowing it; add a regression test and retain preventive sandboxing where available.
scopeProof: Source trace across root resolution, status classification and YAML preflight; live escape reproduction intentionally omitted because it would write outside the lineage.
